capabilities: Create tasks as separate Markdown notes with YAML frontmatter properties
Show tasks in task list, Kanban, calendar and agenda Bases views
Parse dates, times, recurrence, tags, contexts, projects and priorities from natural language
Track time per task with a Pomodoro timer and session history
Sync tasks with Google Calendar and Microsoft Outlook
extras: Full documentation is at tasknotes.dev. Requires Obsidian 1.13.1 or later and the Bases core plugin enabled. Companion web, iPhone and Android apps are in beta and need an mdbase Connect account to work with vault tasks.
intentEvidence: TaskNotes registers its view types with Bases: tasknotesTaskList, tasknotesKanban, tasknotesCalendar and tasknotesMiniCalendar.
problem: Tasks in Obsidian are plain checkboxes inside notes, with no per-task properties, calendar, Kanban board or time tracking.

relations.evidence: Calendar sync with Google Calendar and Microsoft Outlook, and read-only ICS subscriptions
Calendar sync with Google Calendar and Microsoft Outlook, and read-only ICS subscriptions
sync the vault with mdbase Connect, which needs an mdbase Connect account

summary: Task management plugin where each task is a Markdown note, with task list, Kanban, calendar and agenda views built as Bases views.
